answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the anchor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the jetty of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
